text.ko: 업종 내 약한 편. 약점: 총자산이익률(ROA) 3.3%.
text.en: Weak within its sector. Weakness: Return on assets 3.3%.

text.en: Weak within its sector. Weakness: 3-yr revenue growth (annual) -17.6%.

text.en: Weak within its sector. Strength: Inventory growth minus sales growth -27.0%. Weakness: Inventory share of current assets 42.1%.

text.en: Weak within its sector. Strength: Price to book 6.36x. Weakness: PEG ratio n/m (negative).

text.ko: 현재 경제 환경이 이 업종에 불리한 편이에요. 주요 요인: 금리 상승 국면 (불리). 부채가 많은 편이라 금리 영향이 더 커요.
text.en: The current economy tends to work against this sector. Main factor: rising rates (hurts). Higher debt makes it more rate-sensitive.
